screenshots.renderer: real iced view tree, offscreen tiny-skia, no OS window
screenshots.review: All manifest images inspected in contact sheets; full-resolution main, picker, viewer, inline video, account and dirty server-settings spot checks. Manifest hashes and exact PNG dimensions verified.

visual_checks: Artwork-only emoji picker/autocomplete, common art shared with message and reaction rendering; missing art hidden.
GIF results use metadata-sized two-column masonry; category labels centered over dark overlays; KLIPY attribution retained without Esc footer.
Image viewer uses 85% black backdrop, enlarged contain fit, counter inside viewer area, cursor-anchored wheel zoom/pan and fit/actual-size toggle.
Inline video poster/playing/fullscreen controls fit both sizes.
Reviewed modular Settings layout, role pages, context menus and save bars preserved.

playback.note: Silent local testsrc2 files, no OS window, current decoder build

bounds.idle_timers: none when no media is active
bounds.worker_pool: Dedicated bounded video threads do not occupy the shared blocking executor; release on close/offscreen/unfocus.

idle.mode: headless rendered iced view; no OS window; no network or audio

checks.tests: cargo test -p sticktalk -p sticktalk-client-core -p sticktalk-desktop-platform -p sticktalk-media
checks.native_voice: Real endpoint/server Opus and control negotiation test passed; client H.264 ladder matches hardened SFU.

acceptance_limits: Inline container playback currently downloads into a bounded 128 MiB cache; larger attachments remain uploadable/downloadable but need a streaming byte-source player before inline playback can support them.
Real tray menus, HKCU startup registration and OS notification/sound acceptance were deliberately not exercised on the owner PC; tests are dry/mocked.
Existing out-of-scope auth mock change-server screenshot retains its loopback fixture address.

build_hygiene.budget_breach: Accumulated duplicate feature-graph build artifacts transiently exceeded 10 GiB before cleanup. Entire target was removed and final validation rebuilt with a conservative size guard; final guarded peak was about 8.05 GB. This was a budget breach, not an under-budget claim.
build_hygiene.final_target_cleanup: Deleted and verified absent after all tests, clippy, format, screenshots, playback probes and headless memory validation.
